Epic 7 · Lumen screens

The chosen interface style — Lumen with the Field Ops palette (LF5) — applied to the other eight Epic 7 screens, keeping the layouts and row orders approved in round 1 (PH1, TR1, ED1 + LK2 + LS1, LB2 + OA2 + BF2) and the designer's picks BT1, AC1, DP2 + SC3, TL3 (7-UI-5), plus the Results screen with the new slot chip fix.

Still images only. Every frame is at real phone size (568 × 320 with the 44 / 21 px safe edges hatched; 800 × 360). Canvas 2D, the game's own drawings (survivors, parts relit, weapon / gear / building icons, the Downtown bake); Oswald embedded. In play (loot bag, arrow, "Bag found!") the in-play colour rule holds: white = pick-ups, and the orange accent is not used.

Performance (Xiaomi Mi 11i): every plate, texture, backdrop and item close-up is rendered once into a canvas (in the game: baked textures, like hudWarnArt.ts); per frame only the counter digits, one sweep band, a few glow strokes and the scroll offset change. One full-screen frame here ≈ 1–2 ms on a desktop; motion stops entirely with reduced motion. Source: docs/art/epic-7/premium-src/.
